_help: Read by midterms.live.feeds_ne.ne() at every poll; edits take effect without a restart.
non_r: race -> part of the name of the candidate who takes the 'D' (non-Republican) slot. Osborn is an independent.
state_site.race_ids: race -> [type, race id, office seq no]. ne_discover() re-reads tonight's from the site's Media CSV.
counties.<Name>.eid: the county's Clarity election id (results.enr.clarityelections.com/NE/<Name>/elections.json).
state_site.enabled: turned on by Axel 2026-10-30 (his read: the Nebraska.gov portal's no-bots terms don't cover the results site, which shows none and offers data downloads).
